Although Buena Vista's training was 
progressing smoothly—

Look...
you know Buena-san admires someone

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Special Week

text_block_list.text:

around instead of training...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista

balance."

Having a blast is what this traini...

Having fun to our hearts' content ...

text_block_list.text:
You two, the train's coming soon~! Let's 
go!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! First off is Sapporo...
and when it

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? Trainer-san?

myself...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
! ...What a beautiful terrace... ...I

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes, surely all the way across the sea! 
Let's eat soft serve ice cream when we
get 
there♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—The view from the terrace was so very

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Being able to look out all the way to the 
distant mountains... It really refreshed 
my mind. ...So, what about this?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
At this zoo,
you can see animals living in 
near-natural habitats! I'm sure a 
wonderful view awaits us♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Also,
apparently their melon soft serve is

Thanks to Special Week, Buena Vista's

open up—

text_block_list.text:
As for what to do after this... Actually, 
I couldn't decide~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
There's a mountain stream over there, but 
it looks like quite a walk.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, maybe I'll go on a little 
gourmet food tour around here for a bit♪"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... What would you like to do, 
Trainer?

"Sapporo brings together all kinds of 
gourmet foods from across Hokkaido. It 
might be great for building power while 
getting refreshed."

Take a long walk to the mountain s...

Ooh, nice spirit! Trainer-san, let's do

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"When you think of Sapporo, you think of 
miso ramen, right?♪ Ehehe, I can't wait~."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
After that, Jingisukan, zangi, and soup

a day, doesn't it? ♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, you can't eat that much,
can you? 
You don't have to force yourself."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's split everything in half as much as 
we can so we can try all kinds of foods!

And so, in high spirits, our brief, 
multi-day trip to Hokkaido continued—

Summers in Hokkaido aren't as hot and 
humid as on the main island. With this 
climate,
walking around a lot shouldn't be 
too much of a hardship.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then, let's give it our all and 
push on!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Whoa... It's so cool and refreshing...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It feels like we might just forget that 
it's summer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, this soothing feeling is so 
incredible...
It feels like I might forget 
everything else...

text_block_list.name: Spe & Buena
text_block_list.text: Daaaze...

And so, in high spirits, our brief, 
multi-day trip to Hokkaido continued—

The final day arrived before we knew it. 
As for Buena Vista—

Having successfully discharged all that 
pent-up energy, Buena Vista was back to 
her usual gentle self.

text_block_list.text:
That's right...!
Spe-san's roots are right 
here...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Every time I take a deep breath, it 
feels like all the air in my body is
being 
replaced.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You grew up in such a lovely place,
didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's right! That's why before important 
races, I always end up wanting to go home.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah, the Japan Cup was like that too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It was the Japan Cup that you both 
watched.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Just for a few hours, though! Before I 
take on the world,
I just really needed to 
breathe in the air of my hometown.

text_block_list.text:
Being called 'Japan's Supreme 
Commander'... Having everyone place their 
hopes on me...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was feeling a little prickly. But 
looking at this relaxing view...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...All the thorns in my heart just 
completely melt away, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes. —I hope Buena-san feels the same way.

I didn't explain the situation to Special 
Week this time.
She had finally gone home, 
and I didn't want to make her worry 
unnecessarily.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've gained a lot of experience through 
racing, too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I understand what it means to take
even a 
few days off at a critical time like 
this."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let's take a deep breath, Buena-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Take a deep breath of the fresh air and 
the scenery... and let the wind flow 
through your heart!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"If you do that, I'm sure you'll feel 
totally refreshed and ready for a clean 
start!"
